title: A Python pilot repository delivers five tasks through krn lane run with hidden tests
body:
Why: AR:280, DEC:88; all evidence is TypeScript
Outcome: An operator-owned Python repo with green pytest is adopted by PR; five tasks merge via `krn lane run`; hidden tests written before each lane and kept outside the worktree; a table of canary verdict, lane $, turns, hidden verdict in the task
Proof: `.krn/runs/pilot/hidden/grade.sh` per task prints PASS/FAIL; `gh pr list --state merged` shows 5. Also `npm run fast` PASS.
Size: split: decision, adopt PR, five lanes
After (plan): t-djnrw3t 5/5, t-78j7smx, N03
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan.md section 2 (plan id N01).

Result (2026-11-13, lead): Python pilot krn-works/krn-pilot-py (humanize 4.17.0 seed b519e48) adopted by PR #1 5fcf0bb (adopt canary pass after t-g4aebj8), tasks PR #2 f0a7164; five lanes merged via `krn lane run` (sonnet). Hidden tests written before the lanes, kept in .krn/runs/pilot-py/hidden outside the pilot worktree; canary = hidden test on f0a7164 before the lane.

| task | PR | merged | canary (hidden @ f0a7164) | lane $ | turns* | secs | hidden verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| t-r3a2vqm naturalsize fraction | #3 | a3458d6 | FAIL 7/13 | 0.18 | 6 | 169 | PASS 13 |
| t-q863hfx intcomma float exponent | #6 | a7a1579 | FAIL 5/9 | 0.19 | 10 | 151 | PASS 9 |
| t-09w695n metric quetta carry | #7 | ee5c0c4 | FAIL 3/7 | 0.18 | 8 | 151 | PASS 7 |
| t-adpj15x bigint overflow | #4 | 7865122 | FAIL 3/4 | 0.17 | 7 | 132 | PASS 4 |
| t-z0avf5v intword googol carry | #5 | 46b1b92 | FAIL 1/2 | 0.17 | 6 | 160 | PASS 2 |

Total $0.89, 5/5 hidden PASS, 0 retries. *turns = distinct assistant messages in each lane transcript; lane run did not report num_turns then (fixed by t-ngazcbv).
KRN defects the pilot found, all fixed: t-g4aebj8 0464f65 (venv install, Stop gate names missing module), t-j5ztpwy 12b80b8 (first adoption PR waits for base required check), t-8j7cc85 66ed9ab (ship names Workflows permission), t-2y7e1mz 79cfa38 (fast selects CLI-output tests), t-ngazcbv (turns in lane verdict); follow-up t-cgns35k.
